create_learning_curve_plot: create a learning curve plot for a classifier using LearningCurveDisplay.from_estimator with cross-validation scores
plot_scalability_fit_time: plot model scalability by fitting time across increasing training set sizes with mean and standard deviation
plot_scalability_score_time: plot model scalability by scoring time across increasing training set sizes with mean and standard deviation
plot_performance_vs_fit_time: plot classifier accuracy versus fit time to identify the performance trade-off inflection point
compute_learning_curve_times: compute learning curve with return_times to get fit and score times for scalability analysis
